title: पञ्चाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: With the Kaurava army in turmoil and Arjuna and Satyaki and Bhima gone ahead, Drona decides the chief task is to guard Jayadratha. Duryodhana goes to fight, and the Panchala princes take another chariot.
summary.kn: ಕೌರವ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಗೊಂದಲದಲ್ಲಿರುವಾಗ, ಅರ್ಜುನ, ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ, ಭೀಮರು ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋದಾಗ ಜಯದ್ರಥನನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದೇ ಮುಖ್ಯವೆಂದು ದ್ರೋಣ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಹೋರಾಡಲು ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಪಾಂಚಾಲ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರರು ಬೇರೆ ರಥ ಏರುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: कौरव सेना में अव्यवस्था और अर्जुन, सात्यकि तथा भीम के आगे निकल जाने पर द्रोण जयद्रथ की रक्षा को मुख्य कार्य मानते हैं। दुर्योधन लड़ने जाता है और पाञ्चाल राजकुमार दूसरे रथ पर चढ़ते हैं।
summary.te: కౌరవసేన గందరగోళంలో ఉండగా, అర్జునుడు, సాత్యకి, భీముడు ముందుకు వెళ్లగా జయద్రథుని రక్షణే ముఖ్యమని ద్రోణుడు నిర్ణయిస్తాడు. దుర్యోధనుడు పోరాడటానికి వెళ్తాడు; పాంచాల రాకుమారులు వేరే రథం ఎక్కుతారు.
summary.ta: கௌரவப் படை குழம்பி, அர்ஜுனன், சாத்யகி, பீமன் முன்னேறிவிட்ட நிலையில், ஜயத்ரதனைக் காப்பதே முதன்மை என்று த்ரோணர் தீர்மானிக்கிறார். துரியோதனன் போருக்குச் செல்ல, பாஞ்சால இளவரசர் வேறு தேரில் ஏறுகின்றனர்.
summary.ml: കൗരവ സേന കലങ്ങിമറിയുകയും അർജുനനും സാത്യകിയും ഭീമനും മുന്നോട്ടു പോവുകയും ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ, ജയദ്രഥനെ സംരക്ഷിക്കലാണ് പ്രധാന ദൗത്യമെന്ന് ദ്രോണർ തീരുമാനിക്കുന്നു. ദുര്യോധനൻ പോരാടാൻ പോകുന്നു; പാഞ്ചാല രാജകുമാരന്മാർ മറ്റൊരു രഥം എടുക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.105; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तस्मिन्विलुलिते सैन्ये सैन्धवायार्जुने गते ।
सात्वते भीमसेने च पुत्रस्ते द्रोणमभ्ययात् ।
त्वरन्नेकरथेनैव बहुकृत्यं विचिन्तयन् ॥

meaning.en: When that army was in turmoil, with Arjuna gone toward Saindhava, and the Satvata and Bhimasena as well, your son came to Drona in a hurry, in a single chariot, reflecting on the many things to be done.

verses.text:
स रथस्तव पुत्रस्य त्वरया परया युतः ।
तूर्णमभ्यपतद्द्रोणं मनोमारुतवेगवान् ॥

meaning.en: Your son's chariot, carrying great haste and swift as mind and wind, quickly fell on Drona.

verses.text:
उवाच चैनं पुत्रस्ते संरम्भाद्रक्तलोचनः ।
अर्जुनो भीमसेनश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः ॥

meaning.en: With eyes red from agitation, your son said to him, "Arjuna, Bhimasena and the unconquered Satyaki,"

verses.text:
विजित्य सर्वसैन्यानि सुमहान्ति महारथाः ।
संप्राप्ताः सिन्धुराजस्य समीपमरिकर्शनाः ।
व्यायच्छन्ति च तत्रापि सर्व एवापराजिताः ॥

meaning.en: "those great chariot-warriors, tormentors of foes, having defeated all the huge armies, have reached the neighborhood of the king of Sindhu, and there too they all fight unconquered."

verses.text:
यदि तावद्रणे पार्थो व्यतिक्रान्तो महारथः ।
कथं सात्यकिभीमाभ्यां व्यतिक्रान्तोऽसि मानद ॥

meaning.en: "If Partha, the great chariot-warrior, has passed you in battle, how, giver of honor, were you passed by Satyaki and Bhima?"

verses.text:
आश्चर्यभूतं लोकेऽस्मिन्समुद्रस्येव शोषणम् ।
निर्जयं तव विप्राग्र्य सात्वतेनार्जुनेन च ॥

meaning.en: "It is a wonder in this world, like the drying up of the ocean, that you, best of Brahmins, were overcome by the Satvata and by Arjuna."

verses.text:
तथैव भीमसेनेन लोकः संवदते भृशम् ।
कथं द्रोणो जितः संख्ये धनुर्वेदस्य पारगः ॥

meaning.en: "And so too by Bhimasena the world speaks loudly: how was Drona, master of the science of archery, beaten in battle?"

verses.text:
नाश एव तु मे नूनं मन्दभाग्यस्य संयुगे ।
यत्र त्वां पुरुषव्याघ्रमतिक्रान्तास्त्रयो रथाः ॥

meaning.en: "Surely it is my ruin, unlucky as I am, that three chariot-warriors passed you, a tiger among men."

verses.text:
एवं गते तु कृत्येऽस्मिन्ब्रूहि यत्ते विवक्षितम् ।
यद्गतं गतमेवेह शेषं चिन्तय मानद ॥

meaning.en: "Things being so, tell me what you wish to say. What has gone has gone; think of what remains, giver of honor."

verses.text:
यत्कृत्यं सिन्धुराजस्य प्राप्तकालमनन्तरम् ।
तद्ब्रवीतु भवान्क्षिप्रं साधु तत्संविधीयताम् ॥

meaning.en: "Tell me quickly what must now be done at once for the king of Sindhu, and let it be properly arranged."

verses.text: द्रोण उवाच

meaning.en: Drona said:

verses.text:
चिन्त्यं बहु महाराज कृत्यं यत्तत्र मे शृणु ।
त्रयो हि समतिक्रान्ताः पाण्डवानां महारथाः ।
यावदेव भयं पश्चात्तावदेषां पुरःसरम् ॥

meaning.en: "Great king, much must be thought about; hear what concerns me there. Three great chariot-warriors of the Pandavas have passed. As much as the danger is behind, so much is it also ahead of them."

verses.text:
तद्गरीयस्तरं मन्ये यत्र कृष्णधनंजयौ ।
सा पुरस्ताच्च पश्चाच्च गृहीता भारती चमूः ॥

meaning.en: "I think the heavier task lies where Krishna and Dhananjaya are, for the Bharata army is seized in front and behind."

verses.text:
तत्र कृत्यमहं मन्ये सैन्धवस्याभिरक्षणम् ।
स नो रक्ष्यतमस्तात क्रुद्धाद्भीतो धनंजयात् ॥

meaning.en: "There I think the task is to protect Saindhava. He is the one most to be protected by us, dear son, since he fears the angry Dhananjaya."

verses.text:
गतौ हि सैन्धवं वीरौ युयुधानवृकोदरौ ।
संप्राप्तं तदिदं द्यूतं यत्तच्छकुनिबुद्धिजम् ॥

meaning.en: "The two heroes, Yuyudhana and Vrikodara, have gone to Saindhava. This is that very dice game that arose from Shakuni's cunning."

verses.text:
न सभायां जयो वृत्तो नापि तत्र पराजयः ।
इह नो ग्लहमानानामद्य तात जयाजयौ ॥

meaning.en: "In the assembly neither victory nor defeat was reached. Today, dear son, victory or defeat is for us who are staking here."

verses.text:
यान्स्म तान्ग्लहते घोराञ्शकुनिः कुरुसंसदि ।
अक्षान्संमन्यमानः स प्राक्शरास्ते दुरासदाः ॥

meaning.en: "Those fearsome dice that Shakuni staked in the Kuru assembly, thinking of them as dice, are the arrows, hard to withstand."

verses.text:
यत्र ते बहवस्तात कुरवः पर्यवस्थिताः ।
सेनां दुरोदरं विद्धि शरानक्षान्विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: "Know, lord of the people, that where many Kurus stand around, the army is the dice-board and the arrows are the dice."

verses.text:
ग्लहं च सैन्धवं राजन्नत्र द्यूतस्य निश्चयः ।
सैन्धवे हि महाद्यूतं समासक्तं परैः सह ॥

meaning.en: "And the stake, O king, is Saindhava; the decision of the game is here. For with Saindhava a great game has been joined with our foes."

verses.text:
अत्र सर्वे महाराज त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः ।
सैन्धवस्य रणे रक्षां विधिवत्कर्तुमर्हथ ।
तत्र नो ग्लहमानानां ध्रुवौ तात जयाजयौ ॥

meaning.en: "Here all of you, great king, giving up your lives, should duly guard Saindhava in the battle. For us who stake there, victory or defeat is certain."

verses.text:
यत्र ते परमेष्वासा यत्ता रक्षन्ति सैन्धवम् ।
तत्र याहि स्वयं शीघ्रं तांश्च रक्षस्व रक्षिणः ॥

meaning.en: "Go yourself quickly to where those great archers guard Saindhava with care, and protect the protectors."

verses.text:
इहैव त्वहमासिष्ये प्रेषयिष्यामि चापरान् ।
निरोत्स्यामि च पाञ्चालान्सहितान्पाण्डुसृञ्जयैः ॥

meaning.en: "I shall stay right here, and I shall send others, and I shall hold back the Panchalas together with the Pandavas and Srinjayas."

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनः प्रायात्तूर्णमाचार्यशासनात् ।
उद्यम्यात्मानमुग्राय कर्मणे सपदानुगः ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana quickly went at the teacher's command, steeling himself with his followers for the grim work.

verses.text:
चक्ररक्षौ तु पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ ।
बाह्येन सेनामभ्येत्य जग्मतुः सव्यसाचिनम् ॥

meaning.en: The two Panchala wheel-guards, Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas, came around the outside of the army and went to Savyasachin.

verses.text:
तौ हि पूर्वं महाराज वारितौ कृतवर्मणा ।
प्रविष्टे त्वर्जुने राजंस्तव सैन्यं युयुत्सया ॥

meaning.en: Earlier, great king, Kritavarman had held them back when Arjuna entered your army, as they were eager to fight.

verses.text:
ताभ्यां दुर्योधनः सार्धमगच्छद्युद्धमुत्तमम् ।
त्वरितस्त्वरमाणाभ्यां भ्रातृभ्यां भारतो बली ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana, strong Bharata, went in haste to a great fight against those two hurrying brothers.

verses.text:
तावभिद्रवतामेनमुभावुद्यतकार्मुकौ ।
महारथसमाख्यातौ क्षत्रियप्रवरौ युधि ॥

meaning.en: Both rushed at him with raised bows, those two best of kshatriyas, called great chariot-warriors, in the battle.

verses.text:
युधामन्युस्तु संक्रुद्धः शरांस्त्रिंशतमायसान् ।
व्यसृजत्तव पुत्रस्य त्वरमाणः स्तनान्तरे ॥

meaning.en: Yudhamanyu, enraged, hastily sent thirty iron arrows into your son's chest.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनोऽपि राजेन्द्र पाञ्चाल्यस्योत्तमौजसः ।
जघान चतुरश्चाश्वानुभौ च पार्ष्णिसारथी ॥

meaning.en: And Duryodhana, king of kings, killed the four horses of Uttamaujas of Panchala and both his rear guards and his charioteer.

verses.text:
उत्तमौजा हताश्वस्तु हतसूतश्च संयुगे ।
आरुरोह रथं भ्रातुर्युधामन्योरभित्वरन् ॥

meaning.en: Uttamaujas, his horses and charioteer slain in the battle, hastily climbed onto his brother Yudhamanyu's chariot.

verses.text:
स रथं प्राप्य तं भ्रातुर्दुर्योधनहयाञ्शरैः ।
बहुभिस्ताडयामास ते हताः प्रापतन्भुवि ॥

meaning.en: Reaching his brother's chariot, he struck Duryodhana's horses with many arrows, and they fell to the ground dead.

verses.text:
हयेषु पतितेष्वस्य चिच्छेद परमेषुणा ।
युधामन्युर्धनुः शीघ्रं शरावापं च संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: When his horses had fallen, Yudhamanyu quickly cut his bow and quiver with a supreme arrow in the battle.

verses.text:
हताश्वसूतात्स रथादवप्लुत्य महारथः ।
गदामादाय ते पुत्रः पाञ्चाल्यावभ्यधावत ॥

meaning.en: The great chariot-warrior, from his chariot with its horses and charioteer slain, leaped down, took a mace, and ran at the two Panchalas.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य क्रुद्धं परपुरंजयम् ।
अवप्लुतौ रथोपस्थाद्युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ ॥

meaning.en: Seeing your angry son, conqueror of enemy cities, coming at them, Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas jumped down from their chariot-seat.

verses.text:
ततः स हेमचित्रं तं स्यन्दनप्रवरं गदी ।
गदया पोथयामास साश्वसूतध्वजं रणे ॥

meaning.en: Then, mace in hand, he smashed that best of chariots, adorned with gold, with its horses, charioteer and banner, in the battle.

verses.text:
हत्वा चैनं स पुत्रस्ते हताश्वो हतसारथिः ।
मद्रराजरथं तूर्णमारुरोह परंतपः ॥

meaning.en: Having destroyed it, your son, his horses and charioteer slain, tormentor of foes, quickly mounted the chariot of the king of Madra.

verses.text:
पाञ्चालानां तु मुख्यौ तौ राजपुत्रौ महाबलौ ।
रथमन्यं समारुह्य धनंजयमभीयतुः ॥

meaning.en: The two chief Panchala princes, very strong, mounted another chariot and went toward Dhananjaya.
